attribute_fields.COMMENTS: South Carolina military retirement pay exclusion. Full exemption for all military retirement income (Group B). MSRRA compliant. SCRA compliant. SBP payments fully exempt. National Guard drill pay withholding optional.

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Applies SC progressive tax brackets. Brackets: 0% up to $3,560, 3% from $3,561-$17,830, 6% above $17,830. Same brackets for all filing statuses.

context_details.context_comment: Calculate SC taxable income with standard deduction. Hard: EL context grammar lacks inline if/else for branching on filing_status; postfix uses ifelse with allocate/execute/deallocate stack manipulation. Postfix retained as source of truth.
context_details.context_postfix: { sc_standard_deduction_joint } { sc_standard_deduction_single } job.filing_status "MFJ" streq job.filing_status "QSS" streq or ifelse allocate result.agi 0 local@ f- 0 fmax /result.sc_taxable_income xdef execute deallocate pop

condition_details.condition_comment: In bracket 1 only (0%); sc_taxable_income at or below sc_bracket_1_limit
In bracket 2 (3%); sc_taxable_income at or below sc_bracket_2_limit
Zero or negative taxable income; sc_taxable_income at or below 0

action_details.action_postfix: result.sc_taxable_income sc_bracket_1_limit f- sc_bracket_2_rate f* /result.sc_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.sc_state_tax = (sc_bracket_2_limit - sc_bracket_1_limit) * sc_bracket_2_rate + (result.sc_taxable_income - sc_bracket_2_limit) * sc_bracket_3_rate
action_details.action_postfix: sc_bracket_2_limit sc_bracket_1_limit f- sc_bracket_2_rate f* result.sc_taxable_income sc_bracket_2_limit f- sc_bracket_3_rate f* f+ /result.sc_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: SC tax: $428.10 base + 6% on income above $17,830

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates South Carolina state income tax. SC has progressive tax brackets: 0% up to $3,560, 3% from $3,561-$17,830, and 6% above $17,830. SC standard deduction is $15,000 (Single) or $30,000 (MFJ).

action_details.action_postfix: SC_Tax_Brackets " South Carolina State Income Tax:" job.audit_trail swap addto " SC Taxable Income: $" result.sc_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " SC State Tax: $" result.sc_state_tax cvs strconcat " (progressive brackets: 0%/3%/6%)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
